notes.title: Blightspire - v1.2
notes.content: [h1]What's new:[/h1][list][*][p]Improvements regarding enemy AI performance[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where input wasn't working properly when not connected to internet[/p][/*][*][p]Added dynamic volumetric fog that will react to the player's actions[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This will be the final update that the Bubonic Brotherhood team will release for Blightspire. Thanks to everyone who played our game and is going to play our game. This project meant a lot to everyone involved, and we couldn't be more grateful for the response we've seen![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619302/2e19a5b6544f725bff7139ddb9030ea16708f9d7.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Blightspire - v1.1
notes.content: [h3]First of all, we want to thank all of the people who have interacted with us on Discord and Steam with feedback and bug reports! [/h3][p][/p][p]We honestly did not expect our release to have reached as many people as it did and we are very happy with the reception we got.[/p][p]This new update fixes bugs and crashes, and includes a couple game play adjustments. Hope you enjoy![/p][p][/p][h3]What's fixed:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed controller support on Steam Deck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed startup crash on some machines[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed harsh mouse movement after exiting pause menu[/p][/*][/list][h3]What's added:[/h3][list][*][p]Added achievement support[/p][/*][*][p]Added water visuals in the distance[/p][/*][*][p]Added V Sync toggle and FOV slider in the settings menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added more sound effects for player actions[/p][/*][*][p]Added slow down on wave completion and bell sound on wave start[/p][/*][*][p]Added directional damage indicator[/p][/*][/list][h3]What's changed:[/h3][list][*][p]Re-balanced wave enemy counts for easier on-boarding[/p][/*][*][p]Improved ground enemy movement[/p][/*][*][p]Tons more small tweaks and details![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619302/b6ec47e8cccbd2b7d6eb6fce7fcfd19cd3c6b81c.png"][/img][/p][p]Yours Truly, [/p][p]The Bubonic Brotherhood [/p]

notes.title: Patch incoming!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, we wanted to share a quick update regarding our development since the release. First off, thanks so much to everyone for download and playing our game. We did not expect this amount of attention for a student game that we made, but we are incredibly thankful! [/p][p]Over the past week we have been working on make the game more stable, and implementing some quality of life features. We have a bunch planned and cant wait to release the update this week! [/p][p]Including, but not limited to:[/p][list][*][p]Fov Slider[/p][/*][*][p]VSync toggle[/p][/*][*][p]Damage indicator[/p][/*][*][p]20+ achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Improved collision[/p][/*][*][p]Improved enemy navigation[/p][/*][*][p]Improved wave balancing[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved input issues[/p][/*][/list][p]And more![/p][p][/p][p]If you are (or have) run into issues while playing our game, we kindly ask for you to head over to our [url="https://discord.gg/arM6XjtC"]Discord server[/url] so we can assist you further and help resolve the issue.[/p][p]Thanks again to everyone who played! See you soon :)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619302/eced2beb3af13b6524acdb02764a6d886ecbf5fc.png"][/img][/p]
